steps.name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
steps.run_script: rustup toolchain install 1.88.0 --profile minimal

steps.name: Run mandatory PostgreSQL integration tests
steps.run_script: cargo test -p stateknot-store-postgres --test postgres --locked -- --test-threads=1

steps.name: Run durable Graph Driver integration tests
steps.run_script: cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- --test-threads=1

steps.name: Qualify real model adapter, pricing, and exact-key authorization
steps.run_script: cargo test -p stateknot-integrations --test provider_native_postgres --locked -- --test-threads=1

steps.name: Execute recoverable DeepSeek Agent example against PostgreSQL
steps.run_script: cargo test -p stateknot --example deepseek_agent --locked -- --test-threads=1

steps.name: Record process-kill qualification environment
steps.run_script:
{
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'
  sha256sum Cargo.lock
  rustc -Vv
  uname -a
  lscpu
  free -b
  df -T .
  printenv STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE
} | tee failure-close-process-environment.log

steps.name: Qualify committed failure-close process-kill boundaries
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::failure_close::process::failure_close_survives_os_kill_at_each_committed_drain_boundary \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee failure-close-process-qualification.log
# Rust's test harness exits successfully even when a filter matches zero
# tests. Require all six machine-readable checkpoints as well as exit 0.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_PROCESS_KILL_EVIDENCE=' failure-close-process-qualification.log)" = 6

steps.name: Qualify commit loss and expired-fence takeover
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::failure_close::commit_loss::failure_close_commit_loss_and_fence_takeover_are_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee failure-close-commit-loss.log
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' failure-close-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify Join and deadline COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::transaction_commit_loss::join_and_deadline_commit_loss_are_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee join-deadline-commit-loss.log
# Registration, publication and deadline cancellation each require
# both the unforwarded-COMMIT and withheld-response cut.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_JOIN_DEADLINE_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' join-deadline-commit-loss.log)" = 6

steps.name: Qualify child-admission COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::child_admission_commit_loss::child_admission_commit_loss_is_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-admission-commit-loss.log
# Atomic admission requires both an unforwarded COMMIT rollback and
# committed-response-loss recovery from a separate process.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_ADMISSION_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' child-admission-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify child-cancellation delivery COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::child_cancellation_commit_loss::child_cancellation_delivery_commit_loss_is_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-cancellation-commit-loss.log
# Delivery must prove both full rollback and original receipt recovery,
# including atomic cleanup of the real outstanding wait set.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_CANCELLATION_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' child-cancellation-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify child-settlement COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::child_settlement_commit_loss::child_settlement_commit_loss_is_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-settlement-commit-loss.log
# Require rollback and original-event recovery, not a vacuous filter.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_SETTLEMENT_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' child-settlement-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify parent-finalization COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::failure_close::completion_commit_loss::failure_close_completion_commit_loss_is_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee parent-finalization-commit-loss.log
# Require both exact cuts, not a successful zero-test filter.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_PARENT_FINALIZATION_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' parent-finalization-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify child-join consumption COMMIT loss
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::join::consumption_commit_loss::child_join_consumption_commit_loss_is_recoverable \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-join-consumption-commit-loss.log
# Both cut positions must yield independently verified evidence.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_JOIN_CONSUMPTION_COMMIT_LOSS_EVIDENCE=' child-join-consumption-commit-loss.log)" = 2

steps.name: Qualify isolated child-join logical backup restore
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
test -n "$STATEKNOT_TEST_POSTGRES_CONTAINER"
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::join::backup_restore::consumed_child_join_survives_isolated_backup_restore \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-join-backup-restore.log
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_JOIN_BACKUP_RESTORE_EVIDENCE=' child-join-backup-restore.log)" = 1

steps.name: Upload Join and deadline COMMIT-loss evidence
Qualify committed child-join process-loss boundaries
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::join::process::child_join_survives_process_loss_and_rejects_retained_stale_worker \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee child-join-process-qualification.log
# A successful filtered test with partial or missing process evidence
# is not a passing qualification profile.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_CHILD_JOIN_PROCESS_EVIDENCE=' child-join-process-qualification.log)" = 8

steps.name: Qualify deadline cancel-and-join process-loss boundaries
steps.run_script:
set -o pipefail
cargo test -p stateknot-runtime --test postgres --locked -- \
  --exact child_admission::ownership::deadlines::process::deadline_join_survives_process_loss_and_rejects_retained_stale_worker \
  --nocapture --test-threads=1 | tee deadline-join-process-qualification.log
# Both inherited-deadline candidates and every committed recovery
# boundary are mandatory; a partial matrix fails closed.
test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_DEADLINE_JOIN_PROCESS_EVIDENCE=' deadline-join-process-qualification.log)" = 9

steps.name: Record reduced host qualification metadata
steps.run_script:
set -euo pipefail
source_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
source_tree="$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
cargo_lock_sha256="$(sha256sum Cargo.lock | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
dataset_sha256="$(sha256sum docs/scenarios/README.md | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
configuration_sha256="$(printf '%s\n' \
  'profile=ci_reduced' \
  "postgres_image=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE}" \
  'synchronous_commit=on' \
  'topology=1,1,1,1' | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
logical_cpus="$(nproc)"
cpu_model="$(lscpu | awk -F: '/Model name:/ { sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", $2); print $2; exit }')"
test -n "$cpu_model"
memory_bytes="$(awk '/MemTotal:/ { print $2 * 1024 }' /proc/meminfo | cut -d . -f 1)"
kernel="$(uname -sr)"
{
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_SOURCE_COMMIT=${source_commit}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_SOURCE_TREE=${source_tree}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CARGO_LOCK_SHA256=${cargo_lock_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_DATASET_SHA256=${dataset_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CONFIGURATION_SHA256=${configuration_sha256}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_LOGICAL_CPUS=${logical_cpus}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_CPU_MODEL=${cpu_model}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_MEMORY_BYTES=${memory_bytes}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_KERNEL=${kernel}"
  echo "STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_MAJOR=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_MAJOR}"
} | tee -a "$GITHUB_ENV" > reduced-host-qualification-environment.log
printf '%s\n' "postgres_image=${STATEKNOT_QUALIFICATION_POSTGRES_IMAGE}" \
  >> reduced-host-qualification-environment.log

test "$(grep -c '^STATEKNOT_HOST_QUALIFICATION_REPORT=' reduced-host-qualification.log)" = 1
